newsitem.title: USA: Minneapolis schools plan July sale of $61 mln GOs.
newsitem.headline: Minneapolis schools plan July sale of $61 mln GOs.

text.p: Minneapolis Public Schools Finance Director Chuck Irrgang said Thursday the district plans to issue $61 million of general obligation bonds in July.
About $50 million of the bonds will finance current building maintenance projects relating to health and safety issues and the rest for miscellaneous projects, Irrgang said.
The board of education in 1994 had authorized up to $151 million of bonds for the projects and the upcoming issuance will complete that authority, Irrgang said.
Evensen Dodge Inc. has been selected as financial adviser for the sale and Dorsey & Whitney LLP of Minneapolis as bond counsel, Irrgang said.
